source_artifact_refs.consumption_role: Defines the P1 unresolved gate items and field-by-field blocker disposition consumed by this plan.
Defines provider evidence records, drift dimensions, action set, and no-selection / no-fetch locks.
Defines the P1-P4 evidence priority order and provisional benchmark evidence packet minimums.

user_decisions_required_before_any_acces: State the maximum total USD spend allowed for P1 sample validation and whether the ceiling covers one provider, multiple providers, or all P1 candidates.
State whether free public reconstruction only, free trial, token request, paid subscription, vendor sales contact, or no access is allowed.
State the acceptable user classification for market-data terms, including professional versus non-professional and business-use boundaries where relevant.
State whether local storage, non-display use, derived reports, exports, cache retention, and retention after subscription lapse are allowed for each candidate family.
State whether sample-row requests may include active, inactive, delisted, ADR, ETF, SPAC, preferred, fund, and historical membership examples.
decisions_deferred_to_later_review: Provider selection and provider ranking remain separate reviewed decisions after sample validation, not part of this plan.
Any token, trial, paid subscription, sales contact, or endpoint sample request requires explicit user approval after this plan is reviewed.
Any DataHub schema, adapter, runner, or Phase 7c consumption decision requires a later reviewed implementation-design slice.
Any US-long SEC parser feasibility work remains provider-evidence feasibility, not long-alpha validation.

required_user_boundary_decisions: Confirm whether public SEC reconstruction may be used for research-only parser feasibility under fair-access limits.
Confirm that SEC current ticker files will not be treated as historical survivorship-safe security-master evidence.
sample_validation_focus: Submissions and companyfacts rows with accession number, filing accepted timestamp, fiscal period, unit, currency, amendment, and restatement handling.
Parser lineage and fair-access policy for any later reconstruction test.

required_user_boundary_decisions: Confirm whether trial, token, or paid filing-fundamentals access may be requested and under what cost ceiling.
Confirm local storage, derived-report, non-display, retention, and business-use rights before any sample request.
sample_validation_focus: Accepted date, filing date, updated date, is_latest, accession, fiscal period, unit, currency, restatement, and duplicate-filing behavior.
Coverage counts and missing-field rates for the intended US-long universe and history window.

required_user_boundary_decisions: Confirm whether any free, trial, or paid FMP endpoint access is allowed under the P1 cost ceiling.
Confirm whether latest/current endpoints are excluded from historical PIT evidence unless sample rows prove as-of semantics.
sample_validation_focus: SEC filing rows and as-reported statements with filing timestamps, fiscal alignment, units, currency, revisions, and endpoint date semantics.
Cycle-time, outage/status, and missing-field behavior for the target universe.

required_user_boundary_decisions: Confirm professional / non-professional classification and whether Massive / Polygon access is allowed under the cost ceiling.
Confirm local storage, non-display, derived-work, export, quota, and provider-brand/legal-continuity review requirements.
sample_validation_focus: Ticker, listing-state, adjusted aggregate, dividend, split, market-status, halt, zero-volume, and delisted-security examples.
Reconciliation between corporate actions and adjusted OHLCV rows.

required_user_boundary_decisions: Confirm whether Windows/plugin installation, subscription, or trial review is allowed under the P1 cost ceiling.
Confirm whether export, local storage, personal-use, business-use, and retention-after-lapse rights are acceptable.
sample_validation_focus: Survivorship-aware EOD, delisted securities, historical constituent membership, splits/dividends, and listing-state examples.
Proof that Norgate current fundamentals are not used as historical PIT fundamentals.

required_user_boundary_decisions: Confirm whether direct licensed benchmark return feeds may be requested or whether ETF proxy fallback must be reviewed first.
Confirm local-storage and derived-report rights for benchmark series before any benchmark sample request.
sample_validation_focus: Historical return-feed availability for S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Russell 1000, and any sector fallback.
Return type, currency, calendar, dividend reinvestment, missing sessions, and no-zero-fill policy.

required_user_boundary_decisions: Confirm whether issuer-level GICS history sample rows or data dictionary may be requested.
Confirm local storage, derived industry-normalization reports, and security-master mapping rights.
sample_validation_focus: Issuer-level historical GICS membership rows with effective dates, identifier mapping, coverage counts, and fallback from industry to industry group.
Proof that taxonomy methodology pages are not treated as PIT issuer-membership evidence.

required_user_boundary_decisions: Confirm whether table-level data dictionary or sample-row review for Sharadar / Nasdaq Data Link may be requested.
Confirm license, local-storage, call-limit, and table date-key review requirements.
sample_validation_focus: Table-level datekey semantics, filing-date fields, coverage counts, error handling, status behavior, and local-storage constraints.
Proof that product listing, status, or error-code docs are not treated as datekey evidence.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Active and inactive common-equity sample rows across ticker changes, mergers, bankruptcies, OTC transitions, ADRs, ETFs, SPACs, preferreds, and funds.
Identifier mapping rows for provider symbol, CIK, exchange ticker, FIGI when available, and known CUSIP constraints.
coverage_count_checks: Active and inactive coverage counts over the intended US backtest window.
Counts by listing state and security class, including delisted securities.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Sample rows prove historical listing-state eligibility and delisting behavior.
License terms allow the intended local audit storage and derived reporting.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Adjusted EOD rows for liquid, illiquid, halted, zero-volume, newly listed, and delisted securities.
Documentation for split/dividend adjustment mode and total-return limitations.
coverage_count_checks: Date-range and row-count checks for the intended universe.
Missing-bar and holiday handling counts.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Adjusted bars reconcile to corporate-action records for sampled splits and dividends.
Provider terms permit storage of price history and derived return reports.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Split, dividend, merger, spin-off, rights, name-change, share-class, and delisting event examples where available.
Revision timing or as-of reconstruction documentation for corporate actions.
coverage_count_checks: Action-count coverage by event type and history window.
Conflict count between corporate-action records and adjusted OHLCV rows.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Corporate-action samples support reproducible adjustment and no latest-only backfill.
Fallback behavior is documented when corporate actions conflict with adjusted prices.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Filing-linked fundamentals with accepted date, filing date, update date, accession, fiscal period, unit, currency, and restatement/amendment behavior.
Data dictionary or endpoint/table definitions for each candidate fundamentals source.
coverage_count_checks: Coverage counts and missing-field rates for the intended US-long universe and target history.
Separate counts for current, amended, restated, and missing filings where available.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Each production candidate factor has a field-level observed-date construction rule.
Latest/current endpoints are excluded from historical PIT evidence unless sample rows prove as-of semantics.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Historical return-feed sample or data dictionary for S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Russell 1000, and sector fallback where relevant.
Return-type documentation for price return versus total return and dividend reinvestment.
coverage_count_checks: Date-range, missing-session, and missing-month checks for each benchmark.
Calendar alignment checks against the US trading calendar.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Benchmark returns follow the no-zero-fill rule and carry explicit price-return or total-return semantics.
ETF proxy fallback is reviewed separately if direct index returns remain inaccessible.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Issuer-level historical GICS membership rows with effective dates and provider identifiers.
Data dictionary or license terms for GICS History or equivalent issuer-membership source.
coverage_count_checks: Issuer coverage counts by GICS industry and industry group over the intended history.
Counts supporting fallback from industry to industry group when sample size is below threshold.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Issuer-level PIT membership history is proven with effective dates.
Taxonomy methodology pages are not used as membership evidence.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Provider-generated or sample-derived field-by-field coverage counts for the intended US investable universe.
Missing-field and null-rate report for fundamentals, security master, prices, corporate actions, benchmark, and GICS fields.
coverage_count_checks: Counts by universe, field family, historical window, listing state, security class, and provider product tier.
Reproducible row-count lineage from the same path used for sample validation.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Vendor marketing coverage claims are converted into project-specific reproducible counts.
Counts distinguish active, inactive, delisted, ADR, ETF, SPAC, fund, preferred, and common-stock classes.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Plan tier, cost, quota, trial terms, EULA, export, storage, retention, derived-report, and non-display terms for each candidate.
User classification evidence for professional versus non-professional and business use where relevant.
coverage_count_checks: Plan-tier coverage confirmation for delisted coverage, history depth, fundamentals, benchmark, and GICS fields.
Quota and rate-limit sufficiency check for sample validation and later reproducible refresh.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: User-approved cost ceiling and access path are recorded before any provider contact, token, trial, or paid request.
Local-storage, non-display, derived-report, redistribution, export, and retention rights are explicitly classified.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Provider status, outage, error-code, rate-limit, retry, support, and incident surfaces for each candidate.
Field-family fallback hierarchy for missing, stale, license-blocked, incident-affected, or drifted data.
coverage_count_checks: Endpoint-level freshness and error-rate checks once sample access is separately approved.
Outlier, correction, revision, and silent semantic-change checks tied to sample rows.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Status-page evidence is treated as monitoring input only, not endpoint data-correctness proof.
Fallback hierarchy blocks production use rather than silently substituting latest-only or zero-filled data.

required_sample_or_doc_items: Sample rows or data dictionaries for every candidate field family before DataHub table design consumes field names.
Request parameters, provider endpoint/table, timestamps, units, currency, adjustment mode, PIT status, missing fields, and known limitations for each sample.
coverage_count_checks: Row-count reproducibility from the same sample path.
Coverage-count reproducibility by provider, product/tier, source date range, and field family.
pass_criteria_for_later_review: No latest-only endpoint is used for historical PIT evidence.
Every sample has enough lineage to reproduce row counts and identify provider drift later.

required_questions: Does the provider allow local storage of raw rows, normalized rows, lineage metadata, and derived factor outputs for research and audit?
Does the provider allow non-display use by a local analysis system that outputs reports for manual trading decisions?
Does the provider allow derived reports, screenshots, CSV exports, evidence packets, and cached validation artifacts?
What data may be retained after trial expiration, subscription lapse, provider termination, or license downgrade?
What restrictions apply to redistribution, public sharing, professional use, business use, and automated endpoint polling?
Do benchmark and GICS sources allow historical series / membership storage and derived attribution reporting?

required_counts: inactive and delisted security coverage count
ADR, ETF, SPAC, fund, preferred, and excluded class counts
fundamentals field availability and null-rate counts
price, corporate-action, benchmark, and GICS row counts
missing session, missing month, and missing field counts
coverage decay and history-depth counts by provider
pass_criteria_for_later_review: Counts are reproducible from sample or trial access that was separately approved.
Counts are not vendor marketing claims and can be traced to provider, tier, endpoint/table, request parameters, and fetch timestamp.
Coverage gaps are tied to blocking, fallback, or lane-defer decisions instead of silent fill.

required_components: Field-family primary and fallback hierarchy for fundamentals, security master, prices, corporate actions, benchmark returns, and GICS membership.
Manual-review triggers for stale data, missing rows, coverage-count drops, status-page incidents, schema drift, quota exhaustion, and outlier revision rates.
Retry, throttle, backoff, status-page polling, incident logging, and freeze-latest-only-claims rules.
Block-production-use action when no PIT-safe or license-safe fallback exists.
Explicit rule that status pages are not data-correctness proof and zero-fill is forbidden for missing benchmark returns.

decision_gates.required_resolution: User explicitly approves a cost ceiling and allowed access path before any provider contact, account creation, token, trial, paid subscription, or sample request.
A later reviewed packet records local-storage, non-display, derived-report, export, retention, redistribution, professional-use, and business-use rights for each candidate.
After user-approved access boundaries, a separate reviewed packet validates sample rows, coverage counts, field-level PIT semantics, lineage, and fallback behavior.
Phase 7c remains blocked until reviewed Phase 7b evidence and sample-validation blockers are accepted; Phase 7c must start as a schema-first DataHub / report / reproducibility contract.

next_steps: Claude reviews this plan as a non-authorizing Phase 7b-2 closure artifact.
If reviewed and committed, do not request provider access until the user explicitly approves cost ceiling, access path, and license/storage boundaries.
After this reviewed plan is committed, the next alpha-validation execution slice should be A-share minimal-data burst research-only preregistration and falsification.
Keep US-long SEC observed-date / parser feasibility on the provider-evidence track; it can prove construction feasibility, not long-alpha existence.
limitations: This plan synthesizes existing local artifacts only; it does not perform new web research, provider contact, token request, trial start, paid subscription, endpoint call, sample-row collection, provider selection, adapter work, DataHub table work, runner change, broker integration, or ship-gate claim.
Candidate access queue ordering is a validation planning queue, not a provider ranking or selection.
Strong candidate evidence remains blocked until user-approved access boundaries, license/storage rights, sample rows, coverage counts, PIT semantics, and fallback/incident playbooks are reviewed.
Phase 7c remains blocked from consuming P1 fields until the decision gates are separately resolved.
